oracle_banner: ORACLE_WALL: everything in this module is computed after the course, reads the evaluation face only, and enters no arm.  No value here may be supplied to a Fast prompt, written to an Episode bank, or used to choose a program during a run.

naming.is_not_an_oracle: a Scoped policy can beat it and produce a negative regret; the reported quantity is an advantage over a baseline
naming.true_oracle: must cover the Scoped policy (per-UID selection); offline upper bound only

menu.why_this_menu: frozen P1 single operators plus the one composition family AGENTS 5.1 measured positive on both faces; a menu that grew with the result would make the reference a search

fit_bill.why_default_is_zero: a full menu over every unit is thousands of Ridge fits; the bill is approved, not discovered in a log
